title: {{name}} and the Magic Pen
summary: 得到会发光的魔法笔(创造):主角捡到一支会发光的魔法笔,画什么就活什么——画蝴蝶飞起、阴雨天画太阳让花园变亮,最后给朋友画风筝逗她开心。
text:
{{name}} found an old pen in the garden. It was not just an old pen. It glowed with a soft, magic light.

{{name}} drew a little butterfly on a page. Suddenly, the butterfly moved! It flew off the page and into the sky. {{name}} laughed with joy.

"This pen is magic!" {{name}} said. "I will draw more!"

{{name}} drew a red flower by the gate. Slowly, a real flower grew there. Then {{name}} drew a yellow bird. It began to sing a sweet song.

But that day was grey and rainy. The garden looked cold and sad. So {{name}} had a bright idea. {{name}} drew a big, warm sun in the sky.

At once, bright light came into the garden. The flowers opened wide. The rain went away.

{{name}}'s friend Mia walked by. She looked a little sad. {{name}} wanted to help. So {{name}} quickly drew a beautiful kite for her. The kite became real and flew up high.

Mia smiled and ran after the kite. "Thank you!" she shouted.

{{name}} looked at the magic pen and smiled. The best magic was making a friend happy.

questions.prompt: What was special about the pen {{name}} found?
options: It glowed with a magic light

questions.prompt: What did {{name}} draw to help the cold, rainy garden?
Why did {{name}} draw a kite for Mia?
